leadText: Volume 4: Surf's Up, Pikachu is the fourth and final volume of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu created by 小野 敏洋 Toshihiro Ono.
plainText:
Volume 4: Surf's Up, Pikachu is the fourth and final volume of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu created by 小野 敏洋 Toshihiro Ono. 

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: Attack of the Demon Stomach
Chapter 2: You Bet Your Wife
Chapter 3: Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader
Chapter 4: Pikachu's Plan
Chapter 5: Side Story: Ash vs. Gary
Chapter 6: Epilogue: Wild Type

==Major events==
 
rejoins in the Orange Islands.
earns the Orange League championship trophy.
Ash and meet up at a Pokémon research convention.
Ash and Gary begin traveling together.
Jessie and James are revealed to be a married couple.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
( ) in ET15
( 's) in ET19

===Trades===
Ash trades his giant for a photo of May Oak in ET19.

==Gym battles==
Ash battles the following Gym Leaders in this volume: 
Rudy in ET16 (win)
in ET18 (win)

==Monthly releases==
 
Just like the first three volumes, Electric Pikachu Boogaloo was released by VIZ Media as four monthly issues containing one to two chapters each, comprising the entire volume collectively, which was released separately. These monthly comic book issues were released around 2000. As a bonus, these monthly releases each contained fan letters and fan artwork which were not included in the regular volume releases. 

The following monthly comic book issues were released:
Issue 1
Issue 2
Issue 3
Issue 4
